spool_directory.description: Directory where extsmail queues messages before delivery.

external_command.description: Shell command to invoke for delivering each message. Must accept the message on stdin and accept -f for sender.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of delivery attempts for a queued message.

retry_interval.description: Seconds to wait between delivery attempts for a message.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for execution of the external_command.

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use (e.g., MAIL, LOCAL0).

always_bcc.description: Email address to which all messages will be BCC'd (optional).

sender_canonical.description: Regular expression and replacement for canonicalizing the sender address (format: /pattern/replacement/).

recipient_canonical.description: Regular expression and replacement for canonicalizing recipient addresses (format: /pattern/replacement/).

queue_only.description: If true, only queue messages and do not attempt immediate delivery.

externals.description: List of external command override mappings based on conditions (e.g., sender pattern). Each item specifies pattern and command fields.
